label: PF Backlog 491
title: Defect/RCCA: ensure_feature_item broke on Feature dataclass (.get on object swallowed) - backlog-e2e red
body:
Source: precheck --full (2026-10-08) - `backlog-e2e` FAILED after BI-PF-0452/0453 (E2/P1).

DEFECT: `backlog_link.ensure_feature_item` read plan-feature fields with `(feature or {}).get(...)`, but a plan
feature is a `Feature` DATACLASS (not a dict) -> `AttributeError: 'Feature' object has no attribute 'get'`,
swallowed by the function's `except Exception: return None`. Net: for a real Feature OBJECT the function returned
None and created no epic; it only worked when callers passed a dict (which is why the unit test passed but the
end-to-end `e2e_backlog_check` - which passes a Feature object - failed).

RCCA (5-Why):
1. backlog-e2e failed ("feature -> BacklogItem None"). 2. ensure_feature_item returned None. 3. It raised
AttributeError on `.get`. 4. The code assumed a dict; a Feature dataclass has no `.get`; the broad except hid it.
5. Guard: use a type-safe `_fget(feature, key)` (dict OR object) and add a test that passes a Feature OBJECT (the
e2e already covers it; a unit test now locks it).

Fix: `core/backlog_link._fget` + `ensure_feature_item` uses it; test `test_feature_epic_bridge.py`
(Feature object). Verified: `scripts/dev/e2e_backlog_check.py` -> E2E: PASS.
